metadata.case_name: CHEUNG SHING CHI v. LEE KAI YUNG AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: avulsion fracture of the coronoid process of the right ulna.
source: X-ray confirmed avulsion fracture of the coronoid process of the right ulna. Plaster cast was applied and he was discharged from hospital.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of ulna

manifestations.description: Right elbow pain, especially upon writing and sometimes during sleep.
Residual back pain, especially upon prolonged walking or sitting.
Lower limb numbness, especially upon walking up or down stairs.
Depressive mood (referred to the Department of Psychiatry for assessment and management).
Dreaming of the accident at night, and fear of travelling in vehicles driven by other people especially light goods vehicles.
Unable to drive for a prolonged period of time.

treatments_received.treatment: Plaster cast applied to right elbow
source: X-ray confirmed avulsion fracture of the coronoid process of the right ulna. Plaster cast was applied and he was discharged from hospital.
The splint over his right elbow was removed on 31 March 2015 and his injuries were managed conservatively with analgesic.
The splint over his right elbow was removed on 31 March 2015 and his injuries were managed conservatively with analgesic.
He was referred to attend outpatient physiotherapy.

treatments_received.treatment: Referral to Department of Psychiatry for assessment and management
source: At subsequent follow-ups, the plaintiff complained of depressive mood and was referred to the Department of Psychiatry for assessment and management.

treatments_received.treatment: Work capacity evaluation (WCE) done on 17 July 2015
source: WCE was done on 17th July 2015. He reported of pain over low back. There was numbness over his right lower limb. His lifting ability was slightly inadequate. There was decrease in his pushing and pulling…

treatments_received.treatment: Referral to driving assessment by Rehabaid
source: He was referred to driving assessment by Rehabaid.

losses.description: Residual back pain and lower limb numbness affecting prolonged walking, sitting and walking up or down stairs.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Fear of travelling in vehicles driven by other people especially light goods vehicles.
Depressive mood and dreaming of the accident at night affecting social and psychological well-being.
